text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I-It's finally time for the real race...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"To be honest, my heart's been
racing non-stop for a while now...!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
My heart is thrashing around
like it just finished an intense workout...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Maybe I'm just getting anxious.
That's proof I haven't trained enough, isn't it...
choice_data_list: It just shows how fired up they are.
It just shows how fired up they are.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I see, so this fluttering feeling means...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"Then... the reason my legs are shaking
isn't because I'm afraid to race, but—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if she's just itching
to burst into a run right now...!
choice_data_list: Go out there and have a blast!
